roadmap.goal: ADO #6398 'Choosing a Jira Release for a Delivery loads once, and never shows a guess as the answer'. Four slices, each releasable alone, delivered in the order 01 -> 02 -> 04 -> 03. Slice 01: the Delivery dialog (add and edit) never shows a guess: a busy 'Loading…' tab while the sources are unknown, a loading look in both premium tabs while the licence is unknown (Rule-Based enabled), the premium notice only on a licence known not premium, a sources failure notice and a reworded Release-list failure that both ask to reopen the dialog, and `data-widget-status` on the source tab body (with the held E2E fold). Slice 02: the dialog reads the sources from the page's shared keyed query and the Release list starts on opening as a keyed query per opening; the module-level Map and clearDeliverySourceOptionsCache go. Slice 04: the Manual Feature list and the Rule-Based schema are keyed queries per Portfolio and opening with loading and failure looks (optional `loading` prop on FeatureSelector and FeatureGrid; DataGridBase untouched). Slice 03: every Jira Release sweep writes one Information line of counts and time naming no customer, for its purpose (Picker, Preview, Save, Refresh) passed explicitly through IDeliverySourceResolver and IDeliverySourceProvider; documented in docs/settings/systeminfo.md. Done when all 88 pending DISTILL tests are un-skipped and green, the 18 active guards stay green, no `__SCAFFOLD__` remains, no file Epic 6400 changes is in the diff, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` are clean, `dotnet build` has zero warnings and the filtered `dotnet test` is green. Release notes, screenshots, mutation runs and the reporter's post-release reading belong to finalization and are NOT steps here.
roadmap.paradigm_note: The Hypothesis + state-delta unit mandate from nw-roadmap does not apply, deliberately: the frontend is Vitest + React Testing Library without fast-check, the backend NUnit 4 + Moq without a property-testing library. DISTILL authored every scenario example-based, with finite axes as `it.each` / `[TestCase]` / `[TestCaseSource]` tables (premiumVerdictOf x8, dialogQueryStatusOf x8, the licence check x4, the four sweep purposes). RED is removing `it.skip` / `[Ignore]` and watching the test fail on its assertion or on the scaffold's throw, as the feature-delta's RED classification records; GREEN is production code. The only tests DELIVER writes are the one 'forwards loading' case per component in FeatureSelector.test.tsx and FeatureGrid.test.tsx (DEVOPS CI impact) and the purpose argument at existing test call sites. Contract shapes per component are the feature-delta's 'Contract shapes (crafter assertions)' table.
exit_gates: End of every frontend step (all of phases 01, 02, 04): the touched Vitest suites green, then `pnpm test` green and `pnpm build` clean with zero errors and zero warnings in Lighthouse.Frontend (`tsc -b` + `vite build`; prebuild runs `biome check --write`, so run `pnpm exec biome check ./src` read-only first and mind the docs-symlink hazard).

End of every backend step (phase 03): `dotnet build` zero warnings; the touched test classes green; the filtered `dotnet test --filter "TestCategory!=Integration&TestCategory!=JiraIntegration&TestCategory!=LinearIntegration&TestCategory!=AdoIntegration&TestCategory!=ServiceNowIntegration"` green (CLAUDE.md's environmental signatures are not regressions); `JiraDeliverySourceProviderTest` green unchanged. Before the phase-03 push run `TestCategory=JiraIntegration` once locally, because the path classifier makes CI run it.

Epic 6400 boundary (AC-2.6, AC-1.7, AC-4.6): no step lists, and no commit touches, `hooks/useLicenseRestrictions.ts`, `components/Common/LicenseStatus/LicenseStatusIcon.tsx`, `components/Common/DataGrid/DataGridBase.tsx`, `PortfolioRepository` / `IPortfolioRepository`, `PortfoliosController`, `PortfolioController`, `TeamsController`, `TeamController`, `OverviewDashboard.tsx`, `PortfolioDetail`, `TeamDetail`, `services/Api/FeatureService.ts` or `WidgetShell.tsx`; no `["licenseStatus"]` key and no `getLicenseStatus` call is added.
